frozen_rule: For a held-out candidate X, model m, property p, class C: (1) calibration set = other class-C members with a non-null reference (never X), require >= 2 members else ABSTAIN; (2) ratios_i = pred_i / ref_i over calibration members; (3) direction gate: apply only if ALL ratios are strictly on one side of 1, else ABSTAIN; (4) magnitude cap: b = median(ratios), s = max(ratios) - min(ratios), ABSTAIN unless |b - 1| > s; (5) corrected = pred / b; else corrected = pred (abstention, risk-free).

ionics-rocksalt-oos.criterion: corrected beats raw (median |rel err|) on >= 2/3 of evaluable properties with sign-test p < 0.1

perovskite-oos.criterion: corrected beats raw (median |rel err|) on >= 2/3 of evaluable properties with sign-test p < 0.1

kill_condition.registered_text: if the frozen rule fails both groups, the correction layer's scope claim narrows to "same-class lattice constants only" in all public material until new evidence.
kill_condition.note: KILL condition triggered: the frozen rule failed all evaluated groups.
